annotation.title_clean: Empresas y organismos estatales promoverán prácticas éticas en el uso de inteligencia artificial
annotation.title_en: Companies and state bodies will promote ethical practices in the use of artificial intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Presidencia de la República Oriental del Uruguay (gub.uy)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Uruguayan Presidency news item on UNESCO's launch in Uruguay of the Business Council for the Ethics of AI. Officials say Uruguay seeks to legislate to protect rights without stifling innovation, plans a citizen participation platform on AI regulation, and highlights education-focused ethics work by Ceibal.
key_provisions_or_claims: UNESCO launched a Business Council for AI Ethics in Uruguay, linking firms and public sector.
Uruguay favors rights-protecting regulation without 'hyper-cautious' rules that block innovation.
Agesic will open a citizen participation platform on AI regulation and governance.
Council aims at business training, awareness and private-sector input into norm-making.
Ceibal promotes critical thinking about AI among children and girls' STEM participation.
